# UX & Visual Hierarchy Checklist: Rediseño visual y página de inicio (index) de PresupuestosPro

**Purpose**: Revisar la calidad de los requisitos de experiencia de usuario, jerarquía visual, navegación y estados del presupuesto (completitud, claridad, consistencia y medibilidad) antes de implementar.
**Created**: 2026-10-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/design-tokens.md](../contracts/design-tokens.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the four primary navigation destinations explicitly enumerated and consistently named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the content of the activity summary specified (which states are counted and whether clients/services are included)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the labels for all five budget statuses documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the requirements for the redesign defined for every existing screen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the scope of the design tokens (palette, spacing, type scale) fully enumerated as requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the required visual-identity elements of the PDF specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "profesional y sobria" translated into observable or measurable criteria? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "jerarquía visual clara" quantified (which levels exist and what distinguishes them)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "una única fuente de verdad" for the palette defined precisely, including what counts as a violation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the distinction between persisted states and the calculated "Caducado" unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the scope of the "resumen de actividad" quantified (counts only, or also totals)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "utilizable en móvil" quantified with a minimum width and a no-horizontal-scroll criterion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §SC-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the four-section navigation requirements align with the retention of the Borradores area? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the state-transition requirements consistent between User Story 4, FR-012 and the edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the "Caducado" rules consistent between FR-013, Key Entities and Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the "no change to functionality" requirements align with the state-model expansion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018 vs §FR-011–FR-013]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Can "cero colores de marca fuera de la fuente" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the AA contrast requirement testable for each status? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK019 Can "una sola interacción" to reach a section be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "mismos datos y cifras" in the PDF defined concretely enough to verify? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the empty state of the index page? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Are loading and error states defined for the new index page? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements specified for each state-change direction (Enviado ↔ Aceptado ↔ Rechazado)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the alternate flow for reaching a sub-section without the back button documented? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Is the behavior defined when a draft's validity date has passed (must not become Caducado)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for very long text in tables and forms on narrow screens? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the fallback for a missing logo in the redesigned PDF specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the no-renumbering behavior defined when a budget changes state? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Are accessibility requirements (focus, contrast, reduced motion) specified for all interactive and status elements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK030 Are performance expectations for the index page and summary specified? [Gap, NFR]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the backward-compatibility/migration requirement quantified (no data loss)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, §SC-010]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 Is the assumption that "Catálogo" maps to the existing Servicios section documented and validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the assumption that "Enviado" replaces "emitido" documented with its migration implication? [Assumption, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the assumption of "no new dependencies" validated against the typography and design requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK035 Is the scope conflict between the original "no schema change" constraint and the five-state expansion resolved and traceable? [Conflict, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the exact set of screens affected by the redesign unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, contracts/app-routes.md]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
